description: Source code for SAML authentication management in Mattermost, including certificate handling, metadata retrieval, and token management.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct handling SAML operations and configuration updates.

methods.name: writeSamlFile
methods.description: Writes a SAML certificate or key file to platform storage.

methods.name: removeSamlFile
methods.description: Removes a SAML file from platform storage.

methods.name: GetSamlCertificateStatus
methods.description: Checks the status of SAML certificates.

methods.name: GetSamlMetadataFromIdp
methods.description: Fetches and processes SAML metadata from an IdP URL.

methods.name: FetchSamlMetadataFromIdp
methods.description: Performs HTTP GET request to fetch IdP metadata.

methods.name: BuildSamlMetadataObject
methods.description: Parses IdP metadata XML into structured data.

methods.name: SetSamlIdpCertificateFromMetadata
methods.description: Sets IdP certificate from metadata bytes.

methods.name: ResetSamlAuthDataToEmail
methods.description: Resets user auth data to email for SAML users.

methods.name: CreateSamlRelayToken
methods.description: Creates a new SAML relay token.

methods.name: GetSamlEmailToken
methods.description: Retrieves a token by its string value, validating type.
